title: Grilled Australian Lamb Kebabs
description: Tender and flavorful lamb skewers, marinated in a mix of herbs and spices, grilled to perfection. Perfect for a summer evening.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, and oregano.
Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and mix well. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the lamb, bell peppers, and almonds onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Brush the grill with oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the lamb is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
